finalText:
Green: 625/625.

Only 3 of the 625 cases actually failed, all in `order totals`, all the same defect: `orderTotal` applied the tax rate to the **pre-discount** base (`cents * taxRate`) while the spec — and the function's own docstring — says tax is charged on what the customer actually pays. It stayed hidden because every other row in that suite has either a zero discount or a zero tax; only the three rows with both non-zero exposed it.

`src/pricing.js:39` now reads:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Reusing `applyTax` also keeps the rounding identical to the rest of the engine (round the discounted subtotal, then round after tax), which is what the cases compute.
